title: host.health (host → platform, reliable)
description: exited: the server process stopped without the agent stopping it (csm runs CS2 in tmux and cannot see an exit code, so crashed is not sent by this version). hung: running, Ready Up installed, /health not OK for 30 s. recovered: back after hung or exited. restarted: after server.restart. Changes the agent causes itself (its own jobs, and 30 s after them) are not reported.
